prompt.project_info: Create a candid playful indoor portrait of an approved adult woman seated on a plush white sofa in direct sunlight.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair styled in high pigtails, loose strands around the face, playful wink and slight smile. She wears a black corset-style dress with structured seams and short skirt, sits with legs crossed at the knees, one hand resting on the sofa and the other holding a strand of hair.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 seated portrait, subject centered on white plush sofa, large windows and open modern living room behind, strong geometric sunlight and deep natural shadows across wall and sofa.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright direct natural sunlight, high contrast, strong highlights and deep shadows, candid playful mood with realistic skin and fabric.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 3:4 portrait, natural perspective, high detail, accurate hands and hair, realistic window light, controlled highlights, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 3:4 candid indoor portrait of an approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair in high pigtails, loose strands around her face, and a playful wink with a slight smile. She wears a black corset-style dress with structured seams and a short skirt, sits with legs crossed at the knees on a plush white sofa, rests one hand on the sofa, and holds a strand of hair with the other. Use a bright modern living room with large windows, direct sunlight, high-contrast geometric shadows on the wall and sofa, realistic skin and black fabric, natural perspective, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
